about.file: How the editor's Browser (Objects) sorts the game's classes. Read by editor/data.py when the editor starts. After changing categories or what is skipped, delete the project's tools/mapkit/editor/cache/_classes.json so the list is made again.
about.mostUsed: the classes listed first, in this order
about.noModel: classes placed as an icon, without a 3D model
about.categories: a class goes under the first of these it descends from, with this name
about.subcategories: within a category, the class right under it gives the group, named here ('' = no group name)
about.hooks: classes between a category and its groups that are not groups themselves (Revision's)
about.skipClasses: never listed: they crash the editor when placed (a flock spawner, a weapon mod)
about.skipClassPrefixes: never listed, by the start of the name (the weapons only characters carry)
about.skipParents: never listed when they descend from one of these (abstract, effects, projectiles); bodies (DeusExCarcass) are kept
about.npcOnlyWeapons: weapons only creatures and robots use (a dog's bite, a spider bot's discharge): not offered as items to give
